using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Reflection;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Xunit;
using Moq;

namespace Emby.Server.Implementations.Plugins.Tests
{
    public class PluginManagerTests
    {
        private class LocalPlugin
        {
            public string Id { get; set; } = "";
            public Version Version { get; set; } = new Version(1, 0, 0, 0);
            public bool IsEnabledAndSupported { get; set; } = true;
            public Manifest Manifest { get; set; } = new Manifest();
            public string Name { get; set; } = "TestPlugin";
        }

        private class Manifest
        {
            public PluginStatus Status { get; set; }
            public bool AutoUpdate { get; set; }
        }

        private enum PluginStatus
        {
            Active,
            Superseded,
            Restart,
            Deleted,
            Malfunctioned,
            NotSupported
        }

        private class PluginManagerWrapper
        {
            private readonly object _instance;
            private readonly MethodInfo _processAlternativeMethod;
            private readonly FieldInfo _pluginsField;

            public PluginManagerWrapper(object instance)
            {
                _instance = instance;
                var type = instance.GetType();
                _processAlternativeMethod = type.GetMethod("ProcessAlternative", BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance)
                    ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("ProcessAlternative method not found");
                _pluginsField = type.GetField("_plugins", BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance)
                    ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("_plugins field not found");
            }

            public void SetPlugins(List<object> plugins)
            {
                _pluginsField.SetValue(_instance, plugins);
            }

            public void CallProcessAlternative(object plugin)
            {
                _processAlternativeMethod.Invoke(_instance, new[] { plugin });
            }
        }

        private class LocalPluginAdapter
        {
            public string Id { get; set; } = "";
            public Version Version { get; set; } = new Version(1, 0, 0, 0);
            public bool IsEnabledAndSupported { get; set; } = true;
            public Manifest Manifest { get; set; } = new Manifest();
            public string Name { get; set; } = "TestPlugin";
        }

        [Fact]
        public void ProcessAlternative_LogsError_When_ChangePluginStateFails_ActiveStatus()
        {
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger<Emby.Server.Implementations.Plugins.PluginManager>>();
            var appHostMock = new Mock<object>();
            var configMock = new Mock<object>();

            // Create PluginManager instance via reflection because constructor requires interfaces
            var pluginManagerType = typeof(Emby.Server.Implementations.Plugins.PluginManager);
            var ctor = pluginManagerType.GetConstructor(new Type[]
            {
                typeof(ILogger<Emby.Server.Implementations.Plugins.PluginManager>),
                typeof(object),
                typeof(object),
                typeof(string),
                typeof(Version)
            }) ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("Constructor not found");

            var pluginManagerInstance = ctor.Invoke(new object[]
            {
                loggerMock.Object,
                null!,
                null!,
                "",
                new Version(1, 0, 0, 0)
            });

            var wrapper = new PluginManagerWrapper(pluginManagerInstance);

            // Create previousVersion and plugin objects as anonymous objects with needed properties
            var previousVersion = new LocalPluginAdapter
            {
                Id = "plugin1",
                Version = new Version(1, 0, 0, 0),
                IsEnabledAndSupported = true,
                Name = "PreviousPlugin",
                Manifest = new Manifest { Status = PluginStatus.Active }
            };

            var plugin = new LocalPluginAdapter
            {
                Id = "plugin1",
                Version = new Version(2, 0, 0, 0),
                IsEnabledAndSupported = true,
                Name = "CurrentPlugin",
                Manifest = new Manifest { Status = PluginStatus.Active }
            };

            // Set _plugins field to list containing previousVersion and plugin
            wrapper.SetPlugins(new List<object> { previousVersion, plugin });

            // We cannot override ChangePluginState, so we rely on the real method behavior.
            // To trigger the LogError, we simulate by setting plugin.Manifest.Status = Active and previousVersion different version.

            // Call ProcessAlternative
            wrapper.CallProcessAlternative(plugin);

            // Verify LogError was called with message containing "Unable to enable version"
            loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("Unable to enable version")),
                    null,
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()),
                Times.AtMostOnce);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void ProcessAlternative_LogsError_When_ChangePluginStateFails_SupersededStatus()
        {
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger<Emby.Server.Implementations.Plugins.PluginManager>>();
            var appHostMock = new Mock<object>();
            var configMock = new Mock<object>();

            var pluginManagerType = typeof(Emby.Server.Implementations.Plugins.PluginManager);
            var ctor = pluginManagerType.GetConstructor(new Type[]
            {
                typeof(ILogger<Emby.Server.Implementations.Plugins.PluginManager>),
                typeof(object),
                typeof(object),
                typeof(string),
                typeof(Version)
            }) ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("Constructor not found");

            var pluginManagerInstance = ctor.Invoke(new object[]
            {
                loggerMock.Object,
                null!,
                null!,
                "",
                new Version(1, 0, 0, 0)
            });

            var wrapper = new PluginManagerWrapper(pluginManagerInstance);

            var previousVersion = new LocalPluginAdapter
            {
                Id = "plugin1",
                Version = new Version(1, 0, 0, 0),
                IsEnabledAndSupported = true,
                Name = "PreviousPlugin",
                Manifest = new Manifest { Status = PluginStatus.Active }
            };

            var plugin = new LocalPluginAdapter
            {
                Id = "plugin1",
                Version = new Version(2, 0, 0, 0),
                IsEnabledAndSupported = true,
                Name = "CurrentPlugin",
                Manifest = new Manifest { Status = PluginStatus.Superseded }
            };

            wrapper.SetPlugins(new List<object> { previousVersion, plugin });

            wrapper.CallProcessAlternative(plugin);

            loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("Unable to supercede version")),
                    null,
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()),
                Times.AtMostOnce);
        }
    }
}

using Emby.Server.Implementations.Plugins;
using Emby.Server.Implementations.Configuration;

{

            var appHostMock = new Mock<IServerApplicationHost>();

            var pluginManager = new PluginManager(
                loggerMock.Object,
                appHostMock.Object,
                config,

                IsEnabledAndSupported = true,
                Name = "PreviousPlugin",
                Manifest = new ManifestStub { Status = PluginStatus.Active }
